channel.title: SCC Online Web Edition - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from SCC Online Web Edition (scconline.com)

item.title: Bombay High Court explains when Principal Seat continues to retain Jurisdiction despite Establishment of a Circuit Bench
item.description: Bombay High Court explains the Principal Seat's jurisdiction upon the establishment of a Circuit Bench, clarifying why pending matters do not automatically transfer

item.title: Relaxation in qualifying exam doesn't bar reserved category candidates' migration to open category on merit unless expressly prohibited: Supreme Court
item.description: Supreme Court holds that relaxation in a qualifying examination only affects eligibility and does not prevent reserved category candidates' migration to open category on merit unless recruitment rules expressly prohibit such migration.

item.title: Delhi High Court directs Registrar General to consider formulation of Child Access and Custody Guidelines with Parenting Plan
item.description: Delhi High Court directs its Registrar General to consider formulation of Child Access and Custody Guidelines with Parenting Plan.

item.title: Offshore Structures and India’s Insolvency Framework: Navigating Cross-Border Restructuring Complexities
item.description: Explore how offshore jurisdictions like BVI interact with India’s Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. Expert insights on cross-border restructuring, creditor rights, and legal coordination.

item.title: ‘Subjected to structural disadvantages’; SC flags systemic unfairness for women in Armed Forces over consideration of SSCWOs for Permanent Commission
item.description: ‘Subjected to structural disadvantages’; SC flags systemic unfairness for women in Armed Forces over consideration of SSCWOs for Permanent Commission.

item.title: Supreme Court Collegium recommends appointment of Permanent Judges for Madras HC and Chhattisgarh HC
item.description: Supreme Court Collegium recommends appointment of Permanent Judges for Madras HC and Chhattisgarh HC.

item.title: Diversion of preferential allotment funds, contrary to disclosed object, constitutes violation of PFUTP Regulations: Supreme Court
item.description: Supreme Court holds that diversion of preferential allotment funds for purposes other than disclosed objects violates PFUTP Regulations and cannot be cured by shareholder ratification.

item.title: No Habeas Corpus if Wife voluntarily leaves Home; Madras HC Orders Production of Children
item.description: Madras High Court holds that no habeas corpus voluntary departure of wife but directs authorities to secure the minor children for appropriate judicial examination.

item.title: Call for Participation| NUALS MUN 2026 | Registrations Open | Prize Pool ₹80,000
item.description: National University of Advanced Legal Studies hosts NUALS MUN 2026 from March 27-29 with a ₹80,000 prize pool.

item.title: Conversion to Christianity extinguishes SC/ST status and protection under SC/ST Act: Supreme Court
item.description: Supreme Court holds Conversion to Christianity ends Scheduled Caste status under Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950 and protection under the SC/ST Act.

item.title: Call for Registrations | 1st NLU Delhi — Khaitan & Co Certificate Course on Taxation Laws
item.description: National Law University Delhi and Khaitan & Co offer a certificate course on taxation laws on April 3-4, 2026.

item.title: Kerala HC declines to restrain release of web series “Anali”, directs Koodathayi murders’ accused to pursue alternate remedy under IT Rules
item.description: Kerala High Court declines to restrain release of web series 'Anali' and directs Koodathayi murders' accused to pursue alternate remedy under IT Rules.

item.title: Call for Participation | Green Horizon Model United Nations (GHMUN) 2026 | “Ecocide in the Theatre of War: Law, Accountability & the Dying Planet”
item.description: Manipal University Jaipur hosts GHMUN 2026 on ecocide, environmental law, and international accountability.

item.title: “Preservation of fairness and justice necessitates re-examination”; Rajasthan HC directs Independent Medical Board to re-examine Victim’s Injuries
item.description: Rajasthan High Court held that preservation of fairness and justice necessitates re-examination of victims' injuries by independent Medical Board; directs for completion of entire process within 7 days.

item.title: Call for Participation | 2nd Dr. Justice Radhabinod Pal Memorial National Moot Court Competition, 2026
item.description: University of Calcutta hosts the 2nd Radhabinod Pal Memorial Moot Court Competition 2026 on corporate liability and climate change.
